entries.en: The child added a dot above each lowercase j.
entries.zh: 孩子在每个小写字母 j 上方加了一个点。

entries.en: We found x by subtracting seven from both sides of the equation.
entries.zh: 我们将等式两边都减去七，求出了未知数 x。

entries.en: The archive displayed photographs from several presidential campaigns.
entries.zh: 档案馆展出了几次总统竞选活动的照片。

entries.en: A large ginger tom slept beneath the garden bench.
entries.zh: 一只姜黄色的大雄猫睡在花园长凳下。

entries.en: Ian's sketch showed the bridge before its wooden railings were replaced.
entries.zh: 伊恩的素描画出了那座桥更换木栏杆前的样子。

entries.en: We saved the last slice of lemon cake for Alan.
entries.zh: 我们给艾伦留了最后一块柠檬蛋糕。

entries.en: The room became significantly quieter after we closed the windows.
entries.zh: 关上窗户后，房间明显安静了许多。

entries.en: They felt out of place in the tony restaurant wearing muddy boots.
entries.zh: 他们穿着沾满泥的靴子，觉得自己在那家高级时髦的餐馆里格格不入。

entries.en: The audience grew silent as Act III began.
entries.zh: 第三幕开始时，观众安静了下来。

entries.en: Stephen carefully wrapped the cracked bowl in a soft towel.
entries.zh: 斯蒂芬小心地用柔软的毛巾包住裂了的碗。

entries.en: Fewer people came to the evening workshop than we expected.
entries.zh: 来参加晚间工作坊的人比我们预期的少。

entries.en: Ms Jones returned the borrowed ladder with a note of thanks.
entries.zh: 琼斯女士归还借来的梯子时附上了一张感谢便条。

entries.en: The instructions made much more sense after Andrew drew a diagram.
entries.zh: 安德鲁画了一张图后，那些说明就好懂多了。

entries.en: Brian offered his window seat to a child carrying binoculars.
entries.zh: 布莱恩把靠窗的座位让给了一个带着望远镜的孩子。

entries.en: I recognized Chris by the red scarf his sister had knitted.
entries.zh: 我凭他姐姐织的那条红围巾认出了克里斯。

entries.en: The buyer asked whether the table could fit through a narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 买家问那张桌子能否通过狭窄的门口。

entries.en: Even her strongest supporter questioned the need for a larger building.
entries.zh: 连她最坚定的支持者也质疑是否需要一栋更大的楼。

entries.en: Anne noticed a tiny signature hidden in the corner of the painting.
entries.zh: 安妮注意到画作角落里藏着一个小小的签名。

entries.en: A message from Steve arrived just as we boarded the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们刚登上渡轮，就收到了史蒂夫的消息。

entries.en: Jim laughed when his dog brought back a completely different ball.
entries.zh: 吉姆的狗叼回一个完全不同的球时，他笑了。

entries.en: The basket Simon made was strong enough to hold several books.
entries.zh: 西蒙编的篮子足够结实，能装好几本书。

entries.en: Joe checked behind the sofa before declaring the missing keys lost.
entries.zh: 乔在认定钥匙找不到之前，检查了沙发后面。

entries.en: She pressed the graham cracker crumbs into the pie dish.
entries.zh: 她把全麦饼干碎屑压进馅饼盘里。

entries.en: Jane kept the faded postcard between the pages of her diary.
entries.zh: 简把褪色的明信片夹在日记本里。

entries.en: The local museum has a gallery devoted to manufacturing.
entries.zh: 当地博物馆有一个专门介绍制造业的展厅。

entries.en: Our postcard from Glasgow arrived before we returned from the trip.
entries.zh: 我们从格拉斯哥寄出的明信片在我们旅行归来前就到了。

entries.en: He quietly thanked the volunteer without interrupting the speaker.
entries.zh: 他轻声向志愿者道谢，没有打断发言者。

entries.en: The CEO joined the staff for a tour of the new workshop.
entries.zh: 首席执行官和员工一起参观了新车间。

entries.en: Participation in the costume parade is entirely voluntary.
entries.zh: 是否参加化装游行完全自愿。

entries.en: Philip found an old bus ticket inside the secondhand novel.
entries.zh: 菲利普在买来的旧小说里发现了一张旧公交车票。

entries.en: Dr Wilson lent the exhibition a collection of antique cameras.
entries.zh: 威尔逊博士借出一批古董相机供展览使用。

entries.en: Consistent enforcement of the library's quiet rule reduced arguments.
entries.zh: 图书馆始终如一地执行安静规定，减少了争执。

entries.en: Margaret remembered the tune but could not recall the song's title.
entries.zh: 玛格丽特记得旋律，却想不起歌名。

entries.en: The museum displayed a lewis beside the old quarry tools.
entries.zh: 博物馆在旧采石工具旁展出了一件石材吊楔。

entries.en: We ate our sandwiches in the lee of a stone wall.
entries.zh: 我们在石墙的背风处吃三明治。

entries.en: Mr Taylor brought extra chairs down from the attic.
entries.zh: 泰勒先生从阁楼搬下来几把备用椅子。

entries.en: The invitation gives the date as 12 Oct.
entries.zh: 请柬上的日期写的是十月十二日。

entries.en: Keeping the tools dry helped extend their lifespan.
entries.zh: 保持工具干燥有助于延长其使用寿命。

entries.en: Elizabeth's handwriting filled both sides of the little card.
entries.zh: 伊丽莎白的字写满了那张小卡片的正反两面。

entries.en: Luke held the umbrella over the drawings rather than himself.
entries.zh: 卢克把伞撑在画稿上方，而不是自己头顶。

entries.en: Nobody noticed Tim's new glasses until he mentioned them.
entries.zh: 直到蒂姆自己提起，才有人注意到他的新眼镜。

entries.en: The thatcher examined the cottage roof from a wooden ladder.
entries.zh: 茅草屋顶工站在木梯上检查小屋的屋顶。

entries.en: Nigel folded the map along its worn creases.
entries.zh: 奈杰尔沿着磨旧的折痕折起地图。

entries.en: Her travel journal begins with an entry dated 3 Nov.
entries.zh: 她的旅行日记从日期为十一月三日的一篇开始。

entries.en: Mrs Williams planted lavender along the edge of her path.
entries.zh: 威廉姆斯太太沿着自家小径的边缘种了薰衣草。

entries.en: The class watched an archived debate from the Commons.
entries.zh: 全班观看了英国下议院一场辩论的存档录像。

entries.en: We stopped in Gloucester to meet a friend from university.
entries.zh: 我们在格洛斯特停留，与一位大学朋友见面。

entries.en: A local activist organized volunteers to clean the neglected playground.
entries.zh: 一位当地社会活动人士组织志愿者清理了无人照管的游乐场。

entries.en: The documentary examined how communities recovered after acts of terrorism.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了社区在恐怖主义袭击后如何恢复。

entries.en: The envelope addressed to Mr Johnson had no return address.
entries.zh: 寄给约翰逊先生的信封上没有回邮地址。

entries.en: Scott suggested moving the picnic to the sheltered side of the hill.
entries.zh: 斯科特建议把野餐地点移到山坡背风的一侧。

entries.en: She carried the teapot into the ben of the small cottage.
entries.zh: 她把茶壶端进小屋的里屋。

entries.en: The application form is dated 21 Sept.
entries.zh: 申请表上的日期是九月二十一日。

entries.en: The instructions were reasonably clear, even without the pictures.
entries.zh: 即使没有图片，那些说明也相当清楚。

entries.en: Neil listened to the recording twice before answering the question.
entries.zh: 尼尔把录音听了两遍才回答问题。

entries.en: The guide emphasised the importance of staying on the marked path.
entries.zh: 导游强调了沿标记小径行走的重要性。

entries.en: Patrick's homemade bread disappeared before the soup was ready.
entries.zh: 汤还没做好，帕特里克自制的面包就被吃光了。

entries.en: The villain showed no ruth toward the captured travelers.
entries.zh: 那个反派对被俘的旅人毫无怜悯。

entries.en: Implementation of the new timetable took longer than expected.
entries.zh: 新时间表的实施花了比预期更长的时间。

entries.meaningZh: 参见该条（用于交叉引用）
entries.en: This pattern resembles basket weave (q.v.), but uses thicker threads.
entries.zh: 这种纹样类似于篮织纹（参见该条），但使用了更粗的线。

entries.en: Arthur searched the coat pockets for a forgotten shopping list.
entries.zh: 亚瑟在外套口袋里找一张忘在那里的购物清单。

entries.en: The faded photograph has 6 Feb written on the back.
entries.zh: 那张褪色照片背面写着二月六日。

entries.en: She took offense at his careless remark about her painting.
entries.zh: 他对她画作的随口评论冒犯了她。

entries.en: A loose roof tile could potentially damage the parked bicycles.
entries.zh: 一块松动的屋瓦有可能砸坏停放的自行车。

entries.en: The two neighbors disagreed politically but shared a love of gardening.
entries.zh: 这两位邻居政治观点不同，却都热爱园艺。

entries.meaningZh: 香港（Hong Kong 地名的组成部分）
entries.en: We watched the harbor lights from our hotel in Hong Kong.
entries.zh: 我们从香港的酒店里观赏了港湾的灯光。

entries.en: The hong traded tea and silk through its waterfront warehouses.
entries.zh: 这家旧时商行通过其临水仓库经营茶叶和丝绸贸易。

entries.en: Keith brought a folding stool so he could sketch comfortably.
entries.zh: 基思带了一张折叠凳，好舒服地坐着画素描。

entries.en: Anna's little brother insisted on carrying the empty suitcase.
entries.zh: 安娜的弟弟坚持要提那个空行李箱。

entries.en: Chapter IV describes the narrator's first winter in the village.
entries.zh: 第四章讲述了叙述者在村里度过的第一个冬天。

entries.en: We asked Andy to choose the music for the journey.
entries.zh: 我们请安迪为旅途挑选音乐。

entries.en: Helen tucked a pressed flower inside the birthday card.
entries.zh: 海伦在生日贺卡里夹了一朵压干的花。

entries.en: My aunt sent me a sketch of the river in Newcastle.
entries.zh: 姑妈寄给我一幅纽卡斯尔河景的素描。

entries.en: Howard apologized for bringing the wrong box of decorations.
entries.zh: 霍华德为带错装饰品箱子道了歉。

entries.en: The jacket Dave left behind was still hanging by the door.
entries.zh: 戴夫落下的夹克还挂在门边。

entries.en: Lucy smiled when the shy kitten finally approached her.
entries.zh: 胆小的小猫终于靠近她时，露西笑了。

entries.en: "Roger, we will wait by the gate," the driver replied.
entries.zh: “收到，我们会在大门旁等候，”司机回答道。

entries.en: Victoria arranged the photographs by date rather than by size.
entries.zh: 维多利亚按日期而不是尺寸整理了照片。

entries.en: Alexander found the missing chess piece under a cushion.
entries.zh: 亚历山大在靠垫下面找到了丢失的棋子。

entries.en: The novel follows a family living in a remote midland village.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述一个居住在偏远内陆村庄的家庭的故事。

entries.en: We rented bicycles during our stay on Zealand.
entries.zh: 我们在西兰岛逗留期间租了自行车。

entries.en: An economist explained the chart without using complicated jargon.
entries.zh: 一位经济学家不用复杂术语解释了那张图表。

entries.en: "Aha, the missing screw was here all along!" she exclaimed.
entries.zh: “啊哈，丢失的螺丝一直就在这儿！”她叫道。

entries.en: Francis read the final paragraph aloud to check its rhythm.
entries.zh: 弗朗西斯大声读了最后一段，以检查行文节奏。

entries.en: The bathrobe was made of thick white terry.
entries.zh: 那件浴袍是用厚厚的白色毛圈织物做的。

entries.en: Colin paused the film so everyone could refill their cups.
entries.zh: 科林暂停了电影，让大家都能续杯。

entries.en: The diagram shows several servers connected to a SAN.
entries.zh: 图中显示了几台连接到存储区域网络的服务器。

entries.en: Laura recognized the house from her grandmother's description.
entries.zh: 劳拉根据祖母的描述认出了那栋房子。

entries.en: The campsite changed its food provider after repeated late deliveries.
entries.zh: 由于送货屡次迟到，营地更换了食品供应商。

entries.en: Anthony traded his heavy backpack for a smaller shoulder bag.
entries.zh: 安东尼把沉重的背包换成了一个更小的挎包。

entries.en: The twins approached the same puzzle very differently.
entries.zh: 这对双胞胎解同一道谜题的方法大不相同。

entries.en: Nicholas kept a spare pair of socks in his hiking bag.
entries.zh: 尼古拉斯在徒步包里放了一双备用袜子。

entries.en: Douglas turned the chair around to face the garden.
entries.zh: 道格拉斯把椅子转过来，面向花园。

entries.en: A rusty jimmy lay among the theater's collection of stage props.
entries.zh: 一根生锈的短撬棍放在剧院的一堆舞台道具里。

entries.en: In the novel, the earl invites the villagers to a feast.
entries.zh: 小说中，伯爵邀请村民赴宴。

entries.en: Gary untangled the kite string while the children waited.
entries.zh: 孩子们等着时，加理解开了缠在一起的风筝线。

entries.en: The parcel Kate sent contained three tiny knitted birds.
entries.zh: 凯特寄来的包裹里装着三只小小的针织鸟。

entries.en: The purchaser collected the antique mirror in person.
entries.zh: 购买者亲自来取走了那面古董镜子。

entries.en: Integration of the two catalogs made the collection easier to search.
entries.zh: 两个目录的整合使藏品更容易检索。

entries.en: The actor wore a heavy ulster in the winter street scene.
entries.zh: 在冬日街景那场戏中，演员穿着一件厚重的宽大长外套。

entries.en: "Shit, I left the tickets on the kitchen table!" he groaned.
entries.zh: “该死，我把票落在厨房桌上了！”他呻吟道。

entries.en: Her nomination for the award came as a complete surprise.
entries.zh: 她获得该奖项提名，完全出乎意料。

entries.en: Christopher chose a seat where he could see the pianist's hands.
entries.zh: 克里斯托弗选了一个能看见钢琴师双手的座位。

entries.en: The old forge contained an oliver and several worn anvils.
entries.zh: 旧锻工坊里有一架锻锤和几座磨损的铁砧。

entries.en: Lloyd compared the two fabrics in the light by the window.
entries.zh: 劳埃德借着窗边的光比较了那两种布料。

entries.en: Kevin kept stopping to photograph the reflections in the puddles.
entries.zh: 凯文不断停下来拍摄水洼里的倒影。

entries.en: The allocation of rehearsal rooms caused a lively discussion.
entries.zh: 排练室的分配引起了热烈讨论。

entries.en: The quarterback pointed toward the sideline before the next play.
entries.zh: 下一次进攻开始前，四分卫指了指边线方向。

entries.en: The committee formally accepted her offer of help.
entries.zh: 委员会正式接受了她提供帮助的提议。

entries.en: Stuart rolled up the rug before moving the bookcase.
entries.zh: 斯图尔特搬书柜之前先卷起了地毯。

entries.en: A neighbor helped Albert carry the seedlings into the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 一位邻居帮艾伯特把幼苗搬进温室。

entries.en: Lawrence left a bookmark at the start of each chapter.
entries.zh: 劳伦斯在每一章开头都放了一张书签。

entries.en: The costume designer placed a wooden billy beside the police uniform.
entries.zh: 服装设计师把一根木警棍放在警服旁边。

entries.en: Owen's first attempt at pottery became a rather crooked vase.
entries.zh: 欧文第一次做陶艺，做出了一个相当歪斜的花瓶。

entries.en: Rachel spotted the spelling mistake just before the invitations were printed.
entries.zh: 就在请柬付印前，雷切尔发现了那个拼写错误。

entries.en: Mr Russell left his raincoat at the ticket counter.
entries.zh: 拉塞尔先生把雨衣落在了售票柜台。

entries.en: Fred watered the plants while we were away for the weekend.
entries.zh: 我们周末外出时，弗雷德给植物浇了水。

entries.en: Louis tapped the rhythm softly on the edge of his chair.
entries.zh: 路易在椅子边缘轻轻打着节拍。

entries.en: Bernard offered to repair the puppet's broken wooden hand.
entries.zh: 伯纳德主动提出修好木偶坏掉的木手。

entries.en: It is easier to criticise a plan than to improve it.
entries.zh: 批评一个计划比改进它更容易。

entries.en: Hugh brought the old telescope out for a clear evening.
entries.zh: 晚间天气晴朗，休把旧望远镜搬了出来。

entries.en: Stewart shook the sand out of his shoes before entering.
entries.zh: 斯图尔特进门前把鞋里的沙子抖了出来。

entries.en: The exhibition brochure reminded me of our visit to Sheffield.
entries.zh: 展览手册让我想起了我们的谢菲尔德之行。

entries.en: Ms Clarke asked the choir to repeat the final line more softly.
entries.zh: 克拉克女士请合唱团更轻柔地重唱最后一句。

entries.en: Clare tied a blue ribbon around the bundle of letters.
entries.zh: 克莱尔用蓝丝带系住了那捆信。

entries.en: Susan heard her name above the noise of the crowd.
entries.zh: 苏珊在嘈杂的人群中听见了自己的名字。

entries.en: The small publisher brought experimental fiction into the mainstream.
entries.zh: 那家小出版社把实验小说带入了主流。

entries.en: The architect situated the reading room beside a quiet courtyard.
entries.zh: 建筑师把阅览室设在一座安静的庭院旁。

entries.en: A longtime resident showed us photographs of the original station.
entries.zh: 一位久居此地的居民给我们看了原车站的照片。

entries.en: Jackson's backpack was covered with badges from different campsites.
entries.zh: 杰克逊的背包上别满了不同营地的徽章。

entries.en: Frankly, I preferred the smaller painting without the ornate frame.
entries.zh: 坦率地说，我更喜欢那幅没有华丽画框的小画。

entries.en: My grandmother kept a journal of her walking holiday in Sussex.
entries.zh: 祖母保存着她在苏塞克斯徒步度假时写的日记。

entries.en: The miller brushed flour from his sleeves before greeting us.
entries.zh: 磨坊主掸去袖子上的面粉后向我们打招呼。

entries.en: Ann divided the wildflowers between two small glass jars.
entries.zh: 安把野花分插在两个小玻璃罐里。

entries.en: Derek volunteered to read the dragon's lines during the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，德里克自愿读龙的台词。

entries.en: The textbook compares debates in the Lords and the Commons.
entries.zh: 这本教科书比较了英国上议院和下议院的辩论。

entries.en: She enrolled in PHIL 101 after enjoying a lecture on ethics.
entries.zh: 听过一场有趣的伦理学讲座后，她选修了哲学一〇一课程。

entries.en: Emily cut the fabric a little wider than the pattern required.
entries.zh: 埃米莉把布裁得比纸样要求的稍宽了一点。

entries.en: Clinton carefully balanced the tray as he stepped onto the terrace.
entries.zh: 克林顿走上露台时小心地端稳托盘。

entries.en: I received a brief email re the change of venue.
entries.zh: 我收到了一封关于更换场地的简短电子邮件。

entries.en: The tied golfers returned to the course for a playoff.
entries.zh: 打成平手的高尔夫球手们回到球场参加加赛。

entries.en: Joan noticed that the clock in the kitchen was running slow.
entries.zh: 琼发现厨房里的钟走慢了。

entries.en: A robin watched us from the handle of the garden fork.
entries.zh: 一只知更鸟站在园艺叉的柄上看着我们。

entries.en: The librarian found several studies on classroom discussion through ERIC.
entries.zh: 图书馆员通过教育资源信息中心找到了几篇关于课堂讨论的研究。

entries.en: Mr Harris donated his old chess set to the youth club.
entries.zh: 哈里斯先生把旧国际象棋捐给了青年俱乐部。

entries.en: Mrs Moore brought a photograph to help identify the lost dog.
entries.zh: 摩尔太太带来一张照片，帮助辨认那只走失的狗。

entries.en: Ross held the ladder steady while I retrieved the kite.
entries.zh: 我取风筝时，罗斯稳稳地扶着梯子。

entries.en: The researchers recorded behavioral changes in the rescued birds.
entries.zh: 研究人员记录了获救鸟类的行为变化。

entries.en: Caroline wrote the recipe on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 卡罗琳把食谱写在了信封背面。

entries.en: The reading group compared two translations of a book by Marx.
entries.zh: 读书小组比较了马克思一本著作的两种译本。

entries.en: Ms Eliot brought a magnifying glass to the stamp fair.
entries.zh: 艾略特女士带着放大镜去了邮票展销会。

entries.en: The restored footbridge officially opened with a small village celebration.
entries.zh: 修复后的人行桥在村里的一场小型庆典中正式开放。

entries.meaningZh: 莫里斯舞（英国传统民间舞）
entries.en: The dancers performed a morris in the village square.
entries.zh: 舞者们在村庄广场上跳了一支莫里斯舞。

entries.en: Historically, the river was the town's main route for trade.
entries.zh: 从历史上看，这条河曾是该镇的主要贸易通道。

entries.en: A nonprofit theater group organized free performances in the park.
entries.zh: 一个非营利剧团在公园里组织了免费演出。

entries.en: Roy replaced the broken handle on the old picnic basket.
entries.zh: 罗伊换掉了旧野餐篮坏掉的提手。

entries.en: Malcolm measured the doorway before agreeing to take the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 马尔科姆量过门口后才同意接收那个衣柜。

entries.en: The little jenny followed her foal across the field.
entries.zh: 那头小母驴跟着驴驹穿过田野。

entries.en: Allen's drawing included every crack in the old garden wall.
entries.zh: 艾伦的画画出了花园旧围墙上的每一道裂缝。

entries.en: Marie rescued a handwritten note from the pile of wastepaper.
entries.zh: 玛丽从废纸堆里找出一张手写便条，留了下来。

entries.en: We spent a rainy afternoon browsing bookshops in Cardiff.
entries.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们在加的夫逛书店。

entries.en: The seminar examined newspaper coverage of the IRA during the conflict.
entries.zh: 研讨课分析了冲突期间报纸对爱尔兰共和军的报道。

entries.meaningZh: 该死的（粗俗的强调用语）
entries.en: "This fucking printer has jammed again," he muttered in frustration.
entries.zh: “这该死的打印机又卡纸了，”他沮丧地嘀咕道。

entries.en: I would be much obliged if you could return the spare key.
entries.zh: 如果你能归还备用钥匙，我将不胜感激。

entries.en: Geoffrey placed a cloth beneath the vase to protect the table.
entries.zh: 杰弗里在花瓶下面垫了一块布，以保护桌面。

entries.en: The novel opens with a factory worker's unexpected dismissal.
entries.zh: 小说以一名工厂工人意外被解雇开篇。

entries.en: Barbara left the last page blank for a family photograph.
entries.zh: 芭芭拉把最后一页留空，准备放一张全家福。

entries.meaningZh: 希特勒（纳粹德国独裁者）
entries.en: The students discussed a documentary about Hitler in their history class.
entries.zh: 学生们在历史课上讨论了一部关于希特勒的纪录片。

entries.en: Clark remembered to bring batteries for the portable radio.
entries.zh: 克拉克记得给便携式收音机带电池。

entries.en: The archbishop paused to speak with the volunteers outside the cathedral.
entries.zh: 大主教停下来，与大教堂外的志愿者交谈。

entries.en: The diagram shows how these plants reproduce sexually.
entries.zh: 这张图展示了这些植物如何进行有性生殖。

entries.en: The unexplained errors damaged the report's credibility.
entries.zh: 那些未得到解释的错误损害了报告的可信度。

entries.en: Liz drew a tiny star beside her favorite items on the menu.
entries.zh: 莉兹在菜单上最喜欢的菜品旁画了小星星。

entries.en: Harriet climbed the hill to paint the village from above.
entries.zh: 哈里特爬上小山，从高处画那个村庄。

entries.en: A narrow stream wound through the green lea below the cottage.
entries.zh: 一条小溪蜿蜒穿过小屋下方的绿草地。

entries.en: Catherine set aside the smallest shells for her niece's collection.
entries.zh: 凯瑟琳把最小的贝壳留给了收集贝壳的侄女。

entries.en: The research team compared images of the tumor from different scans.
entries.zh: 研究团队比较了不同扫描所得的肿瘤影像。

entries.en: Mr Robinson returned to the café for his forgotten scarf.
entries.zh: 罗宾逊先生回到咖啡馆取落下的围巾。

entries.en: The restored surrey stood beside a sleigh in the carriage museum.
entries.zh: 修复后的轻型四轮马车放在马车博物馆的一架雪橇旁。

entries.en: Donald mixed two shades of blue to match the faded door.
entries.zh: 唐纳德混合了两种蓝色，来配那扇褪色的门。

entries.en: The volunteer coordinator matched each helper with a suitable task.
entries.zh: 志愿者协调员给每个帮手分配了适合的任务。

entries.en: Jonathan left a gap between the shelves for the taller books.
entries.zh: 乔纳森在层板之间留了空隙，用来放较高的书。

entries.en: The old ledger records the scot paid by each household.
entries.zh: 这本旧账簿记载了各户缴纳的摊派税款。

entries.en: Kenneth noticed a loose thread on the embroidered cushion.
entries.zh: 肯尼思注意到刺绣靠垫上有一根松线。

entries.meaningZh: 夏洛特甜点（以面包或蛋糕围边、填入水果等）
entries.en: She served an apple charlotte with a jug of warm custard.
entries.zh: 她端上苹果夏洛特甜点，配了一壶温热的卡仕达酱。

entries.en: A teammate helped her retrieve the ball from the bushes.
entries.zh: 一位队友帮她从灌木丛里找回了球。

entries.en: Some clever johnny had already solved the puzzle before lunch.
entries.zh: 某个聪明的家伙午饭前就已经解开了谜题。

entries.en: Ms Campbell brought spare pencils for the outdoor drawing session.
entries.zh: 坎贝尔女士给户外写生活动带了备用铅笔。

entries.en: Karen sorted the buttons by color in an old biscuit tin.
entries.zh: 凯伦把纽扣按颜色分类，放进一个旧饼干盒。

entries.meaningZh: 弗洛伊德（精神分析学家）
entries.en: The library displayed several biographies of Freud beside the psychology books.
entries.zh: 图书馆在心理学书籍旁陈列了几本弗洛伊德传记。

entries.en: The research report included a section on HIV.
entries.zh: 这份研究报告包含一个关于人类免疫缺陷病毒的章节。

entries.en: The workshop encouraged creativity rather than exact copies of the model.
entries.zh: 工作坊鼓励发挥创造力，而不是照搬范例。

entries.en: The carved wooden bird was incredibly light in my hand.
entries.zh: 那只木雕鸟拿在手里轻得惊人。

entries.en: She rightly pointed out that the labels had been reversed.
entries.zh: 她正确地指出标签贴反了。

entries.en: He felt more comfortable socially after joining the local choir.
entries.zh: 加入当地合唱团后，他在社交上感到更自在了。

entries.en: The museum made an instructional video about weaving.
entries.zh: 博物馆制作了一段关于织造的教学视频。

entries.en: Daniel tucked the concert program inside his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 丹尼尔把音乐会节目单塞进了外套口袋。

entries.en: The archive held campaign posters produced by the GOP.
entries.zh: 档案馆收藏了美国共和党制作的竞选海报。

entries.en: We found a secondhand atlas in a little shop in Norwich.
entries.zh: 我们在诺里奇的一家小店找到了一本旧地图集。

entries.en: Their rented flat in Chelsea had a view of a quiet courtyard.
entries.zh: 他们在切尔西租的公寓可以望见一座安静的庭院。
